additional_info.subject: RE: A new case manager was assigned to 0429062 CRM:00225215669
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The charger 170004324 can back ONLINE after the router -XF4 has been configured again. This it means that I sent a new Restore configuration file, which i attached for reference, and configure again the IPv4 parameters.
So, we figured out that we had to send a new configuration file for resetting properly the WAN configuration.
I attached a picture where you can see that all of the WAN parameters were properly configured but status DOWN. After sending the new restore configuration and inserting the same WAN parameters, the connectivity status is UP again.
Regarding the charger 170004337, the WAN configuration was in mobile while actually was set to WAN. Therefore, the WAN configuration of this router switched automatically from WIRED to MOBILE.
We manually set the new WAN configuration but please investigate why this router is changing the WAN CONFIGURATION.
Thank you,
Valerio Filocamo
